description: This file contains the implementation of serializers and copiers for the generic List<T> type within Orleans Serialization framework. It defines classes for serialization/deserialization (ListCodec<T>) and deep copying (ListCopier<T>) of List<T> objects, including handling reference tracking and custom wire protocols.

classes.name: ListCodec<T>
classes.description: Serializer for List<T>, implementing methods for writing to and reading from serialized form, with support for reference tracking and variable-length list encoding.

classes.name: ListCopier<T>
classes.description: Deep copier for List<T>, supporting efficient cloning and copying of list elements with a provided element copier.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Serializes a List<T> into a writer, including list length and elements.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Deserializes a List<T> from a reader, handling reference tracking and reconstructing the list with elements.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Helper method to serialize a List<T> by writing its length and elements.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Helper method to deserialize list contents from a reader into a List<T>.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of a List<T> using the provided copier.

methods.name: DeepCopy (overload)
methods.description: Copies elements from an input list to an existing output list.
